headline: One procurement partner. Every critical step.
subtitle: Comprehensive buyer-side services tailored to industrial supply chains.

items.title: Supplier Sourcing
items.tagline: Find the right suppliers for your technical and commercial requirements.
items.desc: We identify manufacturers, distributors, and specialized suppliers worldwide capable of fulfilling your technical tolerances and delivery milestones.
points: Alternative sourcing routes for hard-to-find items

items.title: Supplier Verification
items.desc: We assess supplier legal registration, banking verification, production certifications, historical export performance, and commercial risk factors.

items.title: RFQ Management
items.tagline: Turn your requirements into actionable requests.
items.desc: We help structure, translate, and communicate your technical RFQs to qualified international suppliers and coordinate responsive bidding.

items.title: Quote Comparison
items.tagline: Don't choose based on price alone.
items.desc: We organize and compare supplier quotations across landed price, lead time, Incoterms, payment conditions, warranty, and risk scoring.
points: Landed cost and shipping estimate modeling
Commercial terms and risk balance scoring

items.title: Procurement Support
items.desc: We support purchase order execution, manufacturer communication, milestone tracking, pre-shipment inspections, and logistics coordination.
points: Delivery tracking and buyer status reporting
